{{Image}}
A '''holopad''' was a handheld device used to project [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. It required a [[display disk]] to project the holograms. There have been many uses of holopads beginning from the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Meetra Surik]] owned multiple datapads during her exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], some for reading previously entered logs by other individuals, others for passwords and bypassing security measures, and even a few for historical data.
